consumer.name: InteractionCounter_ConfigureActors
consumer.contract: Quotient and remainder values derived from PLAYER_INTERACTION_COUNTER index the same root table for the slot-6 and slot-7 interaction actors.

root_table.name: INTERACTION_COUNTER_ANIMATION_ROOT_TABLE
root_table.selected_roots: The nonzero entries select the 42 four-byte records in ACTOR_ANIM_INTERACTION_COUNTER_FRAME_BANK.

animation_bank.name: ACTOR_ANIM_INTERACTION_COUNTER_FRAME_BANK
decoded: Frame references increment from 0x0CAA to 0x0D4E in steps of four.
Every entry is followed by EC 0x01, clearing actor state.
The bank is contiguous and terminates before ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE55_INTERACTION at 0x00122D54.

boundary_basis: InteractionCounter_ConfigureActors performs the exact table indexing and publishes selected roots to actor records.
The table's 43 longwords end at 0x00004B03 before ROM_SCENE_TRANSITION_TABLE at 0x00004B04.
The bank's fixed four-byte records and known neighboring animation root establish its exact extent.
conclusion: The former 0x00122CAC-0x00122D53 gap is the counter-driven interaction animation bank selected by the root table at 0x00004A58. Its 42 frame/EC01 entries are now canonical, and the sparse table is represented explicitly with its reserved zero slots instead of being treated as opaque fragments.
